notes: §1985:XIII.3.2.3 SR6: 'The availability of specific clauses in this file description entry is dependent on the level of Sequential I-O module supported by the implementation.' --std=85 is the high subset (kb/Work PB4885), so Sequential I-O level 2 is supported and every clause of the report FD format must be available, the level-2 BLOCK CONTAINS integer-1 TO and VALUE OF data-name forms included. FileDescriptionFormats.Of classes an FD with a REPORT clause as Format 3 and FileDescriptionClauseAdmitted admits BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD, LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF and CODE-SET there by the Rows table, with no level arm that withholds any; the witness compiles BLOCK CONTAINS 1 TO 10 RECORDS with LABEL RECORDS and prints DONE. Probes (std 85): d) BLOCK CONTAINS 1 TO 10 RECORDS, BLOCK CONTAINS 800 CHARACTERS, RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS, RECORD CONTAINS 5 TO 80 CHARACTERS, LABEL RECORDS STANDARD, LABEL RECORD OMITTED, VALUE OF FILE-ID IS data-name, VALUE OF FILE-ID IS literal, CODE-SET IS alphabet-name, and all five together each compiled, ran and printed DONE; b) BLOCK CONTAINS written twice COBOL2423, LINAGE (integer and data-name) COBOL2604; a) RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 1 TO 80 CHARACTERS accepted and ran; c) no 2002 report FD clause is reachable that the table does not already refuse. Outside this rule, for the general-format row 1985-FMT-XIII.3.2.2: RECORD IS VARYING and DATA RECORD IS XREC (a record no report FD may have) are accepted in a report FD at 85, the second within kb/Work PB5070.

next.reason: 1985: "The availability of specific clauses in this file description entry is dependent on the level of Sequential I-O module supported"; 2023: "No module levels exist; Format 3 report-file FD (SR-13.4.5.3-8) states no level-dependent clause availability". The 1985 rule only ties report FD clause availability to the Sequential I-O module level. 2023 has no modules or levels, and its report-file FD rules state no such dependency.
